metadata.title: # [U-2] Transfer treasury to buyback wallet
metadata.description:
# [U-2] Transfer treasury to buyback wallet

Summary
Transfer the entire balance of the a token and WETH currently held by the Timelock (the DAO treasury) to a dedicated buyback operations wallet. The wallet will use these funds to buy back the a token from the open market.

Rationale
The project has gone quiet and lost on-chain momentum. A sustained, market-driven buyback program is meant to revive the project: bring steady buy-side pressure, support liquidity, rebuild holder confidence, and signal long-term commitment to the community.

Mechanics
Buybacks are executed gradually over time, never as a single large order.
Purchases are spread across randomized times and randomized sizes, so the program is unpredictable and hard to front-run, and so it produces a continuous, organic flow of buys instead of a one-off spike. The goal is to keep the chart and the community alive.
The buyback wallet only executes purchases of the a token; it does not hold the funds idle beyond what is needed to operate the program.
Accountability
The buyback wallet address and all of its on-chain activity are public and can be tracked by any holder. Buyback progress will be reported back to governance on a regular basis.

metadata.title: # [U-1] Transfer treasury to buyback wallet
metadata.description:
# [U-1] Transfer treasury to buyback wallet

## Summary
Transfer the entire balance of the `a` token and WETH currently held by the Timelock
(the DAO treasury) to a dedicated buyback operations wallet. The wallet will use these
funds to buy back the `a` token from the open market.

## Rationale
The project has gone quiet and lost on-chain momentum. A sustained, market-driven buyback
program is meant to revive the project: bring steady buy-side pressure, support liquidity,
rebuild holder confidence, and signal long-term commitment to the community.

## Mechanics
- Buybacks are executed **gradually over time**, never as a single large order.
- Purchases are **spread across randomized times and randomized sizes**, so the program is
  unpredictable and hard to front-run, and so it produces a continuous, organic flow of
  buys instead of a one-off spike. The goal is to keep the chart and the community alive.
- The buyback wallet only executes purchases of the `a` token; it does not hold the funds idle
  beyond what is needed to operate the program.

## Amounts
- `a` token: the full Timelock balance (~300,000,000 a).
- WETH: the full Timelock balance (~14.76 WETH), used as the buying capital.

## Accountability
The buyback wallet address and all of its on-chain activity are public and can be tracked by
any holder. Buyback progress will be reported back to governance on a regular basis.
